customer_name: Xi'an Public Security Bureau Traffic Management Department (西安市公安局交通管理局)
business_problem: Xi'an traffic police needed a scalable way to handle rising traffic-service inquiries, relieve hotline pressure, remove information silos between frontline officers and functional departments, and standardize both public answers and internal business guidance.
solution_summary: Xi'an Public Security Bureau Traffic Management Department built the large-model assistant 'Yong'anjun' with Baidu AI Cloud using Qianfan AppBuilder and Qianfan ModelBuilder. The system centers on a modular knowledge-base design: one layer supports standardized external answers for vehicle administration, traffic restrictions, and traffic violations, while another organizes internal regulations, business rules, and file lookup for officers. Qianfan ModelBuilder provides the large-model reasoning used to interpret questions and return high-accuracy responses, and Qianfan AppBuilder organizes the online service flows delivered through the agency's WeChat public account. The deployment gives citizens a 24/7 consultation channel and turns the knowledge base into a shared service backbone that reduces 122 hotline load, unifies response language across departments, and assists internal traffic-law enforcement and operations.

solution_components.name: Qianfan AppBuilder
solution_components.role: Organizes the online consultation workflows and public-account delivery used by the traffic-service assistant.

solution_components.name: Qianfan ModelBuilder
solution_components.role: Supplies the large-model capabilities used to interpret traffic-service questions and support internal business consultations.

solution_components.name: Yong'anjun
solution_components.role: Acts as the 24/7 public and internal traffic-service assistant for citizens and police staff.

data_flow: Citizen and officer questions enter Yong'anjun through the WeChat public account and related service channels. Qianfan-backed workflows retrieve governed content from modular external and internal knowledge bases, generate answers for traffic services or law-enforcement guidance, and return the result to users while reducing hotline and manual consultation load.
integration_points: Internal regulations and business-rules knowledge base
business_outcome: Xi'an traffic police created a round-the-clock traffic-service assistant that improved answer accuracy, reduced hotline strain, standardized service responses, and gave internal staff a more efficient way to access governed policy and process knowledge.
metrics: The assistant provides 1,000+ Q&A sessions per day.
The agency's public WeChat account has 5 million followers.
architecture_clues: The deployment uses separate knowledge bases for external public-service answers and internal policy or process consultation
The assistant focuses on vehicle administration, traffic restrictions, and traffic-violation consultation
The system is delivered through the agency's public WeChat channel and is designed to relieve 122 hotline pressure
evidence_quotes: Xi'an traffic police and Baidu AI Cloud launched 'Yong'anjun,' the first intelligent traffic-service system in Shaanxi traffic management to use large-model technology (original: 西安公安交警联合百度智能云推出全国首个交管大模型智能助手“永安君”).
The service reached 96% accuracy, runs 24 hours a day, and handles more than 1,000 consultations per day (original: 实现96%准确率的24小时在线业务咨询，日均服务超1000次).

Before the project, the agency faced three major challenges: a single consultation channel with heavy hotline pressure, information barriers between frontline and functional departments, and inconsistent answer wording for external services (original: 主要面临以下三大挑战：一是服务群众交通业务咨询手段单一，电话热线压力大。二是一线与职能处室存在信息壁垒，对外服务效率低下。三是对外服务解答口径不一致).

The solution uses modular knowledge-base construction and management to create both a standardized external service Q&A base and an internal rules-and-process knowledge base (original: 通过模块化知识库的搭建和管理，打造西安支队对外服务标准问答知识库和对内统一业务规章规范知识库).
Yong'anjun officially launched at the end of January 2025 and became a milestone in smart travel services for Xi'an traffic police (original: “永安君”于2025年1月底正式上线…成为西安公安交警在智能化出行服务方面新的里程碑).
